column4: Create the 6 branches (p1-gateway ... p6-tds), push daily, P1 merges to main
Flash Raspberry Pi OS, enable SSH, give it a fixed IP on the isolated lab network
Install Node 20+ and git on the Pi, clone repo, run: cd gateway && npm install
Install mosquitto on the Pi and run: mosquitto -c devices/mosquitto.conf
Run gateway on the Pi: node gateway.js --host PI_IP; check http://PI_IP:9000/things lists 3 Things
Optional: WebSocket binding (@node-wot/binding-websockets) if proposal requires WS; events are long-poll now
Optional: swap in thingweb.directory if the course wants the real Directory (use --dir)
Run gateway as a service (systemd) so it survives reboot
Wire DHT22 to Pi (data pin GPIO4, 3.3V, GND, 10k pullup if bare sensor)
Install adafruit-circuitpython-dht on the Pi, run: python3 sensor.py --broker PI_IP (drop --mock)
Calibrate DHT22 against a reference thermometer, set --offset
Run python3 sim.py N --broker PI_IP for N = 10, 25, 50, 100 from a separate machine, then gateway on tds/sim
Wire relay module to Pi GPIO17 driving a low voltage DC fan ONLY (never mains)
Run relays with real GPIO: ./run.sh coap (or mqtt) on the Pi; HTTP plug: ./run.sh http
Only one of coap/mqtt relay runs at a time (run.sh handles it)
Run python3 app.py --directory http://PI_IP:9000 and watch fan switch when you warm the sensor
column6: Code done, tested on laptop with mock

column4: Choose --hi / --lo thresholds for the demo, pick a --notify-url (e.g. ntfy.sh topic) or keep console notifications
Check the overheat notification fires (raise sensor past --threshold)
Tag app-frozen, then swap fan CoAP -> MQTT by restarting gateway with fan-mqtt.json; app must run unchanged. Record the result
Run latency harness from a laptop: python3 eval.py latency --gw PI --plug H --coap H -n 200 (several runs)
Run resource logging on the Pi for 10/25/50/100 sim sensors: eval.py resources --label nN
Run eval.py plot, put latency.png and resources.png in the paper
Optional: direct MQTT latency baseline (not in harness)
Run python3 tds/gen.py --broker PI --coap H --plug H with real addresses and commit
Validate every TD in the W3C TD playground (tds/*.json)
Fill in paper.md sections, merge, trim to 4 pages
Full dry run on the Pi: sensor -> gateway -> app -> fan, plus the swap, plus scale
